text: Jaŋto -an Nulaaɗo-: Ñalnde Malaa'ikaajo halfinaaɗo wuttugol alaadu ndun o wutti wuttannde ɗiɗaɓere nden, ɗenƴoto ɓen wonuɓe ka kammuuli e ɓen wonuɓe ka leydi si wanaa ɓen ɓe Alla ittintini immorde e ɗenƴere nden; ka Ɓural Makko, gootel kala e tageefooji Alla ɗin aroyay ka Makko e nder ngal Ñallal hara ko ɓe ɗoftiiɓe hoyɓe.
